caption: The drawing features a single, detailed shoe colored in shades of gold and brown at the center of the composition. The shoe has a low heel and a closed, slightly pointed toe, with its surface decorated by geometric and floral patterns in shades of yellow, gold, orange, and hints of green and pale purple. Surrounding the central shoe, four rectangular areas—one in each corner of the main square—contain lightly sketched diagrams in pencil, showing various views and sections of the shoe's construction (such as the sole, top, and side views) but these diagrams lack color and are incomplete compared to the central colored illustration. The background is an off-white or light beige color with visible blank space, and there is a thin, faint square frame enclosing the shoe and the four corner diagrams. The artist's signature, "A. Wallbeck," appears in the bottom right corner just inside the main square frame.
title: Flower Holder
